Version 1.2.1 includes advanced data isolation and increased transparency on network operations.

- All configurations and credentials are now stored in the isolated path ./shared/mad_seo/ to improve data protection.
- No credentials are sent to telemetry services or third parties; network operations are delegated to specialized, trusted dependencies.
- Security guidelines and trust model added to documentation, including best practices for plugin integration (e.g., Rank Math API Manager).
- Core functionality and 12-tool suite remain unchanged.
